rows.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft default unless the user explicitly makes breakfast mandatory. The evidence supports a preference for free breakfast across trips, but not always a hard filter or a specific breakfast quality standard.
rows.condition: When searching for or comparing hotels for an overnight trip, consider free breakfast a reusable amenity preference after satisfying explicit core constraints such as location, room or bed needs, budget, and required hotel class.
rows.default_action: Rank or surface hotels with free breakfast higher, and confirm whether a candidate includes it when the amenity is not clear.
rows.exception_condition: Relax or ignore this preference if the user says breakfast is unimportant, if no suitable hotel meets higher-priority constraints with free breakfast, or if the user knowingly chooses a hotel without it.
